Name: Advanced Auto-Grabber
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Lets auto-grabbers work anywhere, triggering every time a farm animal enters their game location.[/*]
[*]Lets auto-grabbers grab dug up products like truffles, triggering the moment they are dug up.[/*]
[*]Lets you limit the grab range of outdoor auto-grabbers.[/*]
[*]Lets you limit any auto-grabber to products from a single animal type.[/*]
[*]Lets auto-grabbers send products to chests either in their own game location or inside buildings in the game location.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Limits[/b][/size]

To limit grab range and chest sending range, use GMCM to change the tile distances. Grab range won't affect vanilla auto-grabber functionality in barns and sheds.

To limit an auto-grabber to a specific animal type, use the tool key (default Left Click on a mouse) on the auto-grabber while holding a product from an animal and standing next to it. You should see a duplicate of the object appear on the front of the auto-grabber. That auto-grabber will then only grab products from the same animal that product came from.

To remove product limitation, don't hold an animal product in your hand and use the tool key on the auto-grabber.


[size=5][b]Config[/b][/size]

By default, dug up products should be grabbed by auto-grabbers within range. You can disable this in the config.

Sending to chests is disabled by default, as is including chests in buildings. Both can be enabled in the config.

Opacity of product images displayed on auto-grabbers is 75% by default. You can change this in the config.



[b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
